title: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash available in GitHub Copilot
content: GitHub announced that Microsoft's MAI-Code-1.1-Flash is rolling out in GitHub Copilot. The small-tier coding model adds native vision support and improves coding quality, instruction following, tool use and performance. GitHub says model and serving efficiency lowered the list price by 73% compared with MAI-Code-1-Flash, while annual Copilot subscribers are charged a 0.25-times premium-request multiplier.
selection_reason: A dated primary release notice for a newly available coding model with concrete capability and pricing details.

title: GitHub adds per-model token breakdowns to Copilot usage reports
content: GitHub added per-model token breakdowns to Copilot AI usage reports. The report now shows input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens together with the AI credits consumed by each model, allowing users to trace model costs. The feature is available to Copilot Business and Enterprise administrators and to Copilot individual users.
selection_reason: A primary platform update showing how AI usage cost and token consumption are becoming more observable.

title: OpenAI slows Astra release work over critical cyber-capability concerns
content: Axios reported that OpenAI said internal evaluations could not rule out critical cybersecurity capabilities in its upcoming Astra model. OpenAI expanded safety testing and paused internal activities that did not meet stricter security requirements. Members of OpenAI's technical staff also said testing was being slowed while the company upgraded its security practices.
selection_reason: Independent reporting on a frontier-model delay, internal safety testing and cyber-risk controls.

title: Meta releases Muse Glimmer and outlines a broader open-model strategy
content: Associated Press reported that Meta released the open-source Muse Glimmer model, which can run on a personal computer. Meta also said developers would receive access to the more powerful Muse Spark 1.2 model. The announcements accompanied Mark Zuckerberg's argument that advanced AI capabilities should be distributed broadly rather than controlled by a small number of organizations.
selection_reason: Independent coverage of a recent open-model release and the strategic debate over access to advanced AI.

title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole-body intelligence to robots
content: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2, Gemini Robotics ER 2 and Gemini Robotics On-Device 2. The models cover whole-body vision-language-action control, embodied reasoning for multi-step tasks and efficient local execution. DeepMind says the system can coordinate multiple robots and adapt the on-device model to new robot bodies with a few hours of data.
author: Carolina Parada
selection_reason: A primary release covering embodied reasoning, robot control, on-device adaptation and multi-robot collaboration.

title: OpenAI expands Daybreak and introduces GPT-5.6-Cyber
content: OpenAI expanded the Daybreak program with Blue and Red access tiers and introduced GPT-5.6-Cyber for trusted defensive researchers. OpenAI reports that GPT-5.6-Cyber completed 95.0% of requests in an internal advanced-cybersecurity evaluation, compared with 1.5% for GPT-5.6 Sol and 2.0% for Daybreak Blue access. OpenAI assessed the model at the High cybersecurity-capability threshold and below the Critical threshold.
author: OpenAI
selection_reason: A primary announcement with measurable evaluation results and explicit deployment-safety thresholds.

title: OpenAI expands the Daybreak Cyber Partner Program
content: OpenAI announced that approved Daybreak Cyber Partners will integrate frontier cyber models into governed security products and services. Depending on the engagement, safeguards can include identity verification, defined testing scopes, logging, monitoring and human oversight. Partners are also expected to review model findings before acting on them, keeping deployment within controlled defensive workflows.
author: OpenAI
selection_reason: A primary account of how high-capability AI is being placed into governed enterprise security workflows.

title: OpenAI explains the full-duplex architecture behind GPT-Live
content: OpenAI described GPT-Live as a full-duplex voice model that can listen and speak at the same time without a separate turn detector in the audio path. The system can delegate deeper reasoning or tool use to frontier models asynchronously without interrupting the conversation. Its production architecture combines streaming inference, a dedicated media path, asynchronous delegation and optimized transport.
author: Justin Uberti and Zahan Malkani
selection_reason: A detailed primary engineering account of a recent realtime multimodal AI system.

title: OpenAI commits AI access and funding to the US Genesis Mission
content: OpenAI announced support for the US Department of Energy's Genesis Mission. The commitments include 4 million dollars in Codex access for about 2,000 researchers, 3 million dollars in API support for two scientific campaigns, and up to 10 million dollars in API usage for 2.5 million dollars spent. OpenAI also plans selected access to GPT-Rosalind and advanced cyber capabilities for eligible national-laboratory researchers.
author: OpenAI
selection_reason: A primary announcement connecting frontier AI, public research infrastructure and measurable funding commitments.

title: Google introduces Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber
content: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber, a lightweight cybersecurity model fine-tuned to find, validate and patch software vulnerabilities. Because of the technology's dual-use nature, DeepMind says the model will initially be offered through a limited-access pilot for governments and trusted partners via CodeMender. The controlled rollout is intended to give defenders earlier access while reducing broader misuse risk.
selection_reason: A primary model announcement combining vulnerability research, deployment controls and dual-use risk.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly update adds parallel sessions and isolated worktrees
content: GitHub's August 3 weekly release added workflow improvements across the Copilot app, CLI and Visual Studio Code. The app can show which model handled a completed Auto request and expose available AI-credit and cache details. The CLI adds concurrent-session management, an experimental isolated-worktree command, rewind without Git and live tool-call durations, while Visual Studio Code adds element-level browser feedback and multilingual on-device dictation.
selection_reason: A recent primary release showing concrete changes to coding-agent concurrency, isolation and observability.

title: 腾讯云7月集中升级AI存储、Agent Runtime与开发者工具
content: 腾讯云开发者社区文章梳理了腾讯云2026年7月的AI产品进展，包括AI存储产品组合、Agent Runtime升级和CodeBuddy IDE开启内测。文章称Agent Runtime正从基础可用走向生产级能力，并将CodeBuddy IDE列为新的开发者工具入口。文章还披露混元Hy3一周调用量增长68倍，为国内智能体基础设施和模型使用热度提供了具体观察指标。
author: 先行者也
selection_reason: 中文开发者社区的一手产品梳理，包含Agent基础设施、开发工具和明确调用增长数据。

title: 2026数博会将聚焦词元并设置人工智能大模型市集
content: 新华网转载科技日报报道称，2026中国国际大数据产业博览会将于8月28日至30日在贵阳举行，主题为“词元——数据要素价值释放新路径”。展会将围绕算力底座、数据供给、模型驱动、安全护航和智能体验五个板块展开，汇聚300余家企业。报道还称，展会将设置国内首个专门服务“一人公司”科创主体的人工智能大模型市集，并展示智能体设施、安全智能体等成果。
author: 刘园园
selection_reason: 权威中文媒体报道，覆盖国内算力、数据、模型、安全和小型AI创业生态。

title: 甘肃电投发布紫金驭能电力大模型
content: 中新网甘肃报道，甘肃电投集团发布“紫金驭能”大模型，使用全省60多家电厂超过20年的生产、气象和交易数据训练。模型已用于光伏巡检、风光功率预测、负荷与电价预测、电力交易辅助决策和AI办公。报道披露，AI无人机巡检将全域巡检周期从三个月缩短至一周以内，故障识别精准度超过95%，风光功率预测准确率稳定在90%以上。
author: 王子予、石娇艳
selection_reason: 近期中文行业应用报道，提供训练数据规模、落地场景和可核对的应用指标。

title: Anthropic introduces Claude for Teachers
content: Anthropic introduced Claude for Teachers, giving verified US K-12 educators free access to premium Claude capabilities, teaching skills and evidence-based curricula mapped to standards in all 50 states. The product connects to Learning Commons and includes resources from OpenSciEd and Illustrative Mathematics. Anthropic says teacher data is not used for model training and the product is covered by K-12 privacy terms and a data-processing addendum designed for FERPA compliance.
selection_reason: A primary product release with concrete education access, curriculum integration and student-data safeguards.

title: Anthropic commits 10 million Canadian dollars to AI research
content: Anthropic committed 10 million Canadian dollars to Canadian research institutions for beneficial and responsible AI applications. It announced partnerships with Amii, Mila and the Vector Institute, as well as several hospitals and universities. Anthropic also published a Canadian country brief based on its Economic Index and reported that Canada ranked eighth worldwide in Claude.ai use in its sampled data.
selection_reason: A primary announcement on AI research funding, regional institutions and adoption evidence.
